source.title: Irish News, 5 June 1964, p. 1 ("Rural council election results")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the five counts read in the Irish News of 5 June 1964; the division names are given as that report prints them.

note: Triennial election of Limavady Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. All five outgoing members were re-elected by convincing majorities in the five contested divisions. The division names are transcribed as the report prints them; 'Ballyrena' and 'Ballyharigan' could not be checked against another source and may be misread. Printed: 'Ballyharigan: D. Farren 158, P. O'Neill 56.'
